title: Caperucita Roja
subtitle: Un cuento clásico

pages.text: Caperucita Roja llevaba una canasta a su abuelita enferma.
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#fdf6ec"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><circle cx="350" cy="300" r="50" fill="#f2b64f"/><path d="M300 350 Q350 450 400 350 Z" fill="#d9534f"/><circle cx="350" cy="280" r="40" fill="#f4d0b5"/><path d="M310 270 Q350 230 390 270 Z" fill="#d9534f"/><rect x="420" y="360" width="60" height="50" fill="#c98d5a"/><path d="M420 360 Q450 320 480 360" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="6"/></svg>

pages.text: En el bosque, el lobo le preguntó: —¿A dónde vas, Caperucita?
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#cfe7f8"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><circle cx="250" cy="320" r="50" fill="#f2b64f"/><path d="M200 370 Q250 470 300 370 Z" fill="#d9534f"/><circle cx="250" cy="300" r="40" fill="#f4d0b5"/><path d="M210 290 Q250 250 290 290 Z" fill="#d9534f"/><circle cx="550" cy="350" r="50" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M500 330 L460 310 M500 370 L460 390" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

pages.text: El lobo llegó primero a la casa de la abuelita.
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#fdf6ec"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><rect x="300" y="320" width="200" height="160" fill="#c98d5a"/><path d="M300 320 L400 250 L500 320 Z" fill="#8b5a2b"/><circle cx="600" cy="350" r="45" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M560 330 L530 310 M560 370 L530 390" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

pages.text: El cazador llegó y salvó a Caperucita y a su abuelita.
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#dceefb"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><circle cx="300" cy="320" r="45" fill="#f4d0b5"/><path d="M255 370 Q300 460 345 370 Z" fill="#d9534f"/><circle cx="300" cy="300" r="35" fill="#f4d0b5"/><path d="M265 290 Q300 255 335 290 Z" fill="#d9534f"/><circle cx="520" cy="320" r="50" fill="#69aee6"/><path d="M470 300 L430 280 M470 340 L430 360" stroke="#2f5d85" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="560" y="280" width="20" height="80" fill="#8b5a2b"/></svg>

end_text: Nunca te alejes del camino. Fin.
